node.title: Re^3: Outputting JSON with function () {...} values
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
this should be decodable as JSON

Note that JSON is only a subset of JavaScript, you can see the grammar e.g. [http://www.json.org/|here] - it doesn't even allow comments. That's why Perl's most common [cpan://JSON] modules, or [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/JSON/parse|browsers], won't handle it. Although the example code can be parsed with JavaScript's eval, of course that's a huge security hole because it allows for arbitrary code execution, which is one of the reasons why JSON was invented in the first place.
